senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עָזַז)strong, firm; vehement, rough; (of colors) bright, intense; (of smell and taste) pungent, acrid.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 67b:6">Yoma 67ᵇ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="P00392"><he>עזאזל</he></cite>) <he>שיהא עז וקשה</he> the mountain must be rough and hard (rocky).

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 852:16">Yalk. Ps. 852</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 99:4">Ps. XCIX, 4</cite>) you will find, <he>מי שהוא עז וכ׳</he> he who is powerful does not care to abide by the law; Midr. Till. to Ps. l. c. ed. Bub. <cite ref="P00215"><he>עוז</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
Ab. V, 20 הוי עז כנמר וכ׳ be strong (energetic) like a tiger … to do the will of thy Father in heaven; a. fr.—עז פנים insolent, impudent. Ab. l. c.; a. e.—Fem. עַזָּה.
<cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 1:1">Neg. I, 1</cite>, a. fr., v. <cite ref="B00194"><he>בַּהֶרֶת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Keritot 6a:52">Ker. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי שתהא ע׳</he> that it may have a pungent flavor.—Pl. <he>עַזִּים</he>, <he>עַזִּין</he>; <cite ref="P00402"><he>עַזּוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Beitzah 25b:8">Bets. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני מה … מפניּ שהם ע׳</he> why was the Law given to Israel? Because they are impetuous (and the Law was to discipline them).
<cite ref="Beitzah 25b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>שלשה ע׳ הן וכ׳</he> three (creatures) are of a vehement temper, Israel among the nations, the dog among the beasts &c.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 30b">Sabb. 30ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 16b:23">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>עַזֵּי פנים</he> insolent people, v. <cite ref="P00402"><he>עַזּוּת</he></cite>.
